newsitem.title: USA: Cooper Industries completes debenture call.
newsitem.headline: Cooper Industries completes debenture call.

text.p: Cooper Industries Inc said Frdiay that $188 million of its $194 million of 7.05 percent convertible subordinated debentures had been converted into 4.6 million shares of Cooper common stock.
The remainder of the debentures will be redeemed for cash on May 22, it said.

With the completion of this call, Cooper has now retired all $690 million of its 7.05 percent convertible subordinated debentures, the company said. It said $610 million of principal had been converted into 14.8 million shares.
Cooper Industries said the improved balance sheet will enable the company to pursue additional acquisitions and boost returns to shareholders.
